summary: Preserve one conversation; separate slide browsing from edit targeting, receipt recovery from new attempts, and split layout by available space.
invariants: Keep draft and conversation context across generation and result layout transitions.
Viewing a slide does not change the edit target; explicit scope is pinned at send time.
Distinguish uncertain admission, same-request retry, changed-input new attempt, and result-fetch retry.
Use actual progress data and a useful request summary when intermediate content is unavailable.
Size split layout from available container space; dragging does not switch to tabs.
Define event transitions and inline required choices before UI rollout.
forbidden: Starting a duplicate generation to recover an uncertain receipt.
Automatically sending a draft after generation completes.
